20224.long_desc:
Our 32 inch Monitor Frame with Glass is designed for our Arcooda 32inch LCD monitor, and is a perfect solution for upgrading or repairing your Game Wizard Xtreme, Taito Vewlix, and China made Chewlix arcade cabinets. Monitor Frame and Glass support Mounting for the Following Machines
  • Arcooda Xtreme 1, 2 and 3
  • Taito Vewlix L, Vewlix F, Vewlix FC, Vewlix Diamond
  • Chewlix arcade cabinets
    • Installation is super easy and little technical skill needed. The bracket has both side and top/bottom holes for side mounting of the frame, as well as using the brackets sent with the monitor. Simply connect our 32 inch monitor via the 4 included L-Shaped monitor brackets and you're ready to go! Perfectly matched with our 32 inch arcade LCD Monitor (sold separately). Or you could use a suitable 3rd party monitor and make your own manual adjustments. (we take no responsibility for any 3rd party modifications required, you may need spacers or other adapters).
